method.name: get_abi_version
method.description: Returns the pixal3d C ABI version this build links against. Bumps whenever any signature or struct layout in [code]trellis2_capi.h[/code] changes; a runtime that expects a specific ABI checks this before calling anything else.

method.name: image_to_glb
method.description: One-shot [code]image bytes[/code] to GLB bytes. [code]opts[/code] names the GGUF checkpoints the pipeline needs and the generation knobs. Required keys: [code]dino_gguf[/code], [code]ss_flow_gguf[/code], [code]ss_dec_gguf[/code]. Optional keys naming further GGUFs: [code]slat_flow_gguf[/code], [code]slat_hr_flow_gguf[/code], [code]shape_dec_gguf[/code], [code]shape_enc_gguf[/code], [code]tex_dec_gguf[/code], [code]tex_flow_gguf[/code], [code]tex_flow_hr_gguf[/code]. Optional knob keys: [code]pipeline_type[/code] (0 auto, 1 coarse, 2 512-fine, 3 1024-cascade), [code]background_mode[/code] (0 auto, 1 keep, 2 black, 3 white), [code]seed[/code], [code]steps[/code] (default 25), [code]guidance[/code] (default 3.0), [code]texture_steps[/code] (default 0), [code]texture_size[/code] (default 1024), [code]component_filter[/code] (default -1). Returns an empty [PackedByteArray] on any error; the reason is pushed through [method @GlobalScope.printerr].
